 For the avoidance of doubt, notwithstanding anything contained herein or in the Agreement to Sell, the Licensee shall be liable for all risk and costs applicable to the Purchased Unit as and from the Effective Date (including loss of or damage to the Purchased Unit or any part thereof). 
 
 TERMS OF LICENSE 
 
 The License granted shall be conditional upon strict compliance and adherence by the Licensee to the following: 
 
 timely payment of monthly Service Charges to the Management Company in clear funds; 
 Rules, including but not limited to the Permitted Use specified therein; 
 maintaining the Purchased Unit in habitable and liveable condition; 
 timely payment of monthly utility charges with respect to the Purchased Unit; and 
 timely deposits of Instalment Payment with the Licensor under the Payment Plan appended to the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 The Licensee understands and acknowledges that the License is conditional permission to occupy the Purchased Unit and does not create or transfer any rights, title or interest in the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer or the sub-licensee except to the extent envisaged under th is License Agreement . 
 
 The Licensor shall, to the extent possible, assign to the Licensee the benefit of any valid manufacturer s’ warranties on and from the Effective Date , in respect of any White Goods provided in the Purchased Unit under th e Agreement to Sell . The Licensor makes no independent representation or warranty in this regard, including with respect to the fitness for use or quality of any White Goods and has relied on the manufacturers’/suppliers’ representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all White Goods in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of the same, and the Licensor shall have no liability thereof including but not limited to any extension in the warranty periods

 SUBLICENSE 
 
 The Licensee shall have the right to sublicense the Purchased Unit during the license period subject to the issuance of an NOC by the Licensor on such terms and conditions as specified by the Licensor . 
 
 A sublicense shall be issued on the same terms and conditions and subject to completion of the necessary formalities and documentation by the Licensee, as prescribed by the Licensor . 
 
 The Licensee shall have the right to charge a sublicensing fee against a sublicense in accordance with clause 4 .1 above, at his discretion. 
 EVENT OF DEFAULT AND TERMINATION 
 5. 1 In the event of noncompliance or default by the Licensee on payment of the remaining Instalment Payments or any other payment or condition as prescribed in this License Agreement or the Agreement to Sell , the Licensor shall have absolute right and entitlement to revoke the License under Clause 12 of the Agreement to Sell . For the sake of clarity, the revocation of the License by the Licensor shall automatically revoke the sublicense granted by the Licensee (if any). 
 GENERAL TERMS 
 It is clarified that, as per Clause 5 .3 of the Agreement to Sell, all risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Effective Date . In contrast, rights in the Purchased Unit shall be transferred with actual possession, i.e. upon payment of all instalments and fulfilment of all obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell in accordance with Clause 6 of the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 This License Agreement shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement of the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement to Sell shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the License Agreement shall prevail, and any conflicting term(s) in the Agreement to Sell shall be deemed amended appropriately . 
 
 The License Agreement may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute the same agreement .
